sources.title: elephant-1 - 16K context, open source | LLM Reference
sources.snippet: elephant-1 is a 9B open-weight decision model from Base Labs, Baseten's research lab, released October 21, 2026. It is a full fine-tune of Qwen3.5-9B that turns a state and typed questions into calibrated probabilities for choice, yes/no and score answers in a single forward pass, without generating free-form text, for routing, classification and rubric scoring. sources.title: elephant-1: Baseten's 9B Open Decision Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: elephant-1 is a 9B-parameter decision model from Base Labs, the research lab at Baseten, announced on October 21, 2026 alongside the 27B mammoth-1. It is post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B.
